name: 可読性スコア
description: 測定します 可読性 consistency にわたる content segments.
useCase: Detecting AI text through uniform 可読性 levels
mechanism: Divides content into segments and 測定する complexity 分散. AI text maintains consistent 可読性 throughout, unlike 人間の文章 は naturally varies.
source: Ippolito et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Generated Text, ACL
parameters: ウィンドウサイズ: 適応型, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: エントロピー, CV, 相関
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成の text
- Language-agnostic 統計的 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 誤検出
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies にわたる 文体s

references.title: Ippolito et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Generated Text, ACL
Gehrmann, S. et al. (2019). GLTR: Statistical Detection and Visualization of Generated Text. ACL Demo.
Dugan, L. et al. (2023). Real or Fake Text?: Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries Between Human-Written and Machine-Generated Text. AAAI.
